primitives.note: Pierce deals its physical damage on a fixed 0.25s cast/short travel, on a flat 9s cooldown, gated by mana cost 60-80.

Rend stacks are applied to the target by basic attacks (on-hit) and by Pierce, refreshing a 4s timer up to 254 stacks; casting Rend consumes all stacks on the target for base damage plus escalating per-stack bonus damage.

Rend's ddragon cooldown is 0 (it is gated by needing a stacked nearby enemy, not a timer); in a 15s dummy fight its real throttle is the 30 mana cost per cast plus how fast stacks rebuild, not a cooldown bar.
Martial Poise's note that Kalista 'cannot keep up' past 2.1 attack speed caps the effective benefit of stacking attack speed for her auto-attack damage output.
If Rend kills at least one target its cooldown resets and mana is refunded; largely inapplicable against a dummy with meaningful health but listed for completeness/kill-time edge cases.

needsBespoke.why: Q and E's damage and stack-consumption mechanics map cleanly onto plain-cast and target-stacks; the attack-speed cap on P is a straightforward attack-speed-interaction. W's bonus damage and R's entire kit are built around a second champion (the Oathsworn ally) applying an independent Soul-Mark or being rescued; since the specified fights have no allies, these two abilities simply never produce a damage/survival effect rather than requiring new bespoke logic to express.

unsettled.question: W's Soul-Mark bonus magic damage only triggers when BOTH Kalista's own mark and the Oathsworn ally's mark land on the same target. With no ally present in either simulated fight, can this damage instance ever occur?
options: Never procs; W contributes zero damage in the dummy/survival fights as specified
Simulator should assume a proxy 'Oathsworn' applies the second mark automatically, letting W deal its bonus damage roughly once per PerTargetCooldown (10s)
quotes: If both '''Kalista's''' and the ''Oathsworn's'' ''Soul-Mark'' are applied to the same enemy, the marks are consumed to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target

unsettled.question: Rend's ddragon cooldown field is 0, but the bin also carries a per-rank FakedCooldown of [10/9.5/9/8.5/8] and the wiki tooltip shows a leveled cooldown of 10-8s. Is Rend actually spammable every 0.25s cast time (limited only by mana and stack availability), or does it behave like a real ~8-10s cooldown for rotation purposes?
options: Rend has no true cooldown; it can be recast as fast as the 0.25s cast time and 30 mana allow, as long as a stacked target is in range
FakedCooldown is the true gate and Rend can only be cast roughly every 8-10s depending on rank

unsettled.question: Martial Poise's note that Kalista 'cannot keep up with attack speed values greater than 2.1' — does this actually cap her real attack rate (and thus on-hit/Rend-stacking throughput) at high attack speed, or does it only describe the dash mechanic falling behind while her attacks still fire at full uncapped speed?
options: Effective attack speed for damage purposes is hard-capped at 2.1
Attack speed for damage/attack-rate purposes is uncapped; only the cosmetic dash-repositioning breaks down at high AS
quotes: {{ai|Martial Poise|Kalista}} cannot keep up with attack speed values greater than {{fd|2.1}}, due to the combination of her auto attack windup taking too long, and her dashes being too slow.

unsettled.question: A documented bug: casting Rend during Pierce's cast time (before the Pierce projectile spawns) repeats Rend's first-spear damage on a target already hit by Rend, in addition to empowering the Pierce projectile. Should the optimal rotation exploit this double-dip, or should it be excluded as an unintended bug likely to be patched?
options: Include the Pierce-cast-time Rend overlap as part of the maximum-damage rotation
Exclude it and treat Rend/Pierce as non-overlapping casts
quotes: If ''Rend'' is used during the cast time of {{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}, before the projectile spawns, doing so will repeat the first-spear damage to a target already damaged by ''Rend'', {{bug|2}} in addition to empowering the projectile with ''Rend's'' effects.

proposal: Open with Pierce (Q) for its high base+AD-ratio physical damage and to apply the first Rend stack to the dummy.
Auto-attack continuously between ability casts; each basic attack applies/refreshes a Rend stack (on-hit) and can be interleaved with Sentinel or Rend's cast time without breaking attack cadence.

Cast Rend (E) as soon as a stack is on the target and mana allows, to consume accumulated stacks for burst physical damage; recast it every time it becomes available (interval depends on the cooldown-vs-mana ruling above) rather than waiting to bank many stacks, since damage per stack beyond the first is a fraction of the base.
Recast Pierce every 9s on cooldown, re-applying a Rend stack each time so Rend always has something to consume.
Do not cast Sentinel (W) or Fate's Call (R) for damage purposes; they have no target/effect in an ally-less dummy or survival fight.
Maintain uninterrupted auto-attacking as the default action whenever no ability is off cooldown, since Kalista has no attack-reset or empowered-attack mechanic to hold attacks for.
questions: How fast can Rend actually be recast in practice (see the FakedCooldown vs true-cooldown-0 unsettled question) — this directly changes how many Rend casts fit in the 15s window and thus the rotation's cadence.
Should the simulator model any Rend/Pierce cast-time overlap trick, or keep casts strictly sequential?
Is there any scenario in the specified fights where an Oathsworn ally proxy should be assumed so that W's Soul-Mark damage is included in the rotation at all?
Does stacking attack speed past ~2.1 actually keep raising Kalista's attack rate/on-hit Rend-stacking rate, which would change how attack-speed items are weighted in the rotation and build ranking?
